laws.name: Texas Military Family Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for employees who are spouses of military members called to active duty or on leave from deployment.

laws.name: Texas Crime Victim Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for employees who are victims of a crime to attend court proceedings or participate in the criminal justice process.

laws.name: Texas State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Texas state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: Texas State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows Texas state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
